title: Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIX OF 2018
ACT XIX OF 2018
SINDH EMPLOYEES OLD-AGE BENEFITS
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act to amend the Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits Act, 2014
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 17th May, 2018]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-16/2018, dated 17.5.2018.---The Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits (Amendment) Bill, 2018 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 20th April, 2018 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 12th May, 2018 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Employees Old-Age Benefits Act, 2018, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Employees Old-Age Benefits (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
